howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 golden_chat 的 Slack 聊天记录，包括工程和随机频道的讨论、代码片段、共享链接等。
howto.when: 当用户询问 golden_chat 聊天历史中的解决方案、代码片段、团队决策或故障排除步骤时触发。

say.text: 在 #engineering 频道里，关于故障排除有什么讨论？
say.note: Claude 会搜索工程频道的相关聊天记录。

say.text: Bob 分享过哪些 Python 代码片段？
say.note: Claude 会列出 Bob 分享的高质量代码。

say.text: 给我看看 golden_chat 聊天中共享的链接。
say.note: Claude 会返回聊天中分享的链接列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query golden_chat Slack chat history, including discussions, code snippets, and shared links from engineering and random channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about solutions, code snippets, team decisions, or troubleshooting steps from golden_chat chat history.

say_en.note: Claude will search relevant chat records in the engineering channel.

say_en.text: What Python code snippets did Bob share?
say_en.note: Claude will list high-quality code shared by Bob.

say_en.text: Show me the shared links from golden_chat.
say_en.note: Claude will return a list of links shared in the chat.
